description: This file defines the Request class, which models an HTTP request within the AWS CRT HTTP namespace, including methods for construction, marshalling, unmarshalling, and accessing the request body stream.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, extending the Message class, and includes properties like the body stream, along with methods for construction, marshalling, unmarshalling, and body stream access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with HTTP method, path, query parameters, headers, and an optional body stream, validating the type of the body stream if provided.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the Request object into a format suitable for transmission or storage by calling the parent class's marshall method.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes data into a Request object, utilizing the parent class's _unmarshall method.

methods.name: body_stream
methods.description: Returns the body stream associated with this request, if any.
